contentField.label: Content Field Name
contentField.extra: Specify the JSON field used as document content (optional, auto-detects content/text/passage/document)

warning.embeddingRequired: Vector retrieval mode requires an Embedding model. Please select one in the model configuration below.
warning.embeddingOptional: No Embedding model configured. Similarity filtering will be skipped (optionally configure Embedding to auto-filter duplicates).
warning.evalEmbeddingRequired: Eval data generation mode requires an Embedding model. Please select one in the model configuration below.

validation.selectLLM: Please select an LLM model first
validation.evalEmbeddingRequired: Eval data generation mode requires an Embedding model
validation.retrievalEmbeddingRequired: Vector retrieval mode requires an Embedding model

evalLlm.label: Eval LLM (Optional)
evalLlm.tooltip: Separate evaluation model for chunk positive/negative classification. Falls back to the LLM above if not selected.

similarityThreshold.label: Similarity Threshold
similarityThreshold.embeddingTooltip: QA pairs with embedding cosine similarity > this value will be filtered
similarityThreshold.rerankTooltip: Candidates with rerank score above this value will be filtered (treated as near-duplicates). Set to 1 to disable.

retrievalTopK.label: Retrieval Top-K
retrievalTopK.tooltip: Number of candidate chunks retrieved per query

timeout.label: Per-Document Timeout (sec)
timeout.tooltip: Total time limit from when a document enters the pipeline to completing all steps

steps.title: Processing Steps Configuration

qaGen.title: QA Generation
qaGen.useRoleTooltip: When enabled, automatically generates differentiated roles based on document content. Each role generates 1 QA.

qaDedup.title: QA Deduplication
qaDedup.description: Remove duplicate QA pairs based on query hash

posNeg.title: Positive/Negative Generation

evalMode.label: Eval Mode
evalMode.tooltip: Chunk evaluation mode: batch returns indices at once (fast but with position bias); individual calls per chunk (unbiased, most accurate, N times the cost)

augment.tooltip: Use LLM to supplement generation when retrieval results are insufficient

supplementPositives.tooltip: Add retrieved positive chunks as positives (chunk mode) or extract supporting statements as positives (statement mode)

confirmPositives.tooltip: Use LLM to verify extracted positive statements, filtering hallucinations and irrelevant statements (additional LLM calls)

confirmNegatives.tooltip: Use Delta calculation + LLM confirmation to filter hard negative statements (requires Rerank or Embedding model)

answerRewrite.tooltip: LLM merges query + answer into a complete self-contained statement as the first positive

rerankScoreClassification.tooltip: Score each statement, discard weak negatives below the worst positive score, and do LLM re-verification on low-score positives (requires Rerank or Embedding model)

evidenceRemoval.tooltip: Remove evidence from positive chunks to generate hard negative variants

evidencePruning.tooltip: Trim irrelevant content from positive chunks to generate cleaner positives

negChunkScoring.tooltipStatement: Score negative chunks, keep only high-scoring chunks and extract statements, discard low-scoring chunks (requires Rerank or Embedding model)
negChunkScoring.tooltipChunk: Score negative chunks, keep only those scoring above the worst positive as hard negatives (requires Rerank or Embedding model)

skipEasyNegatives.tooltip: Negatives ranked after all positives are already distinguishable by the model, low training value

skipPerfectAp.tooltip: AP=1 means ranking is already perfect, model doesn't need to learn from this data

posNeg.skipEasyWarning: When ranking is completely correct, all negatives are easy negatives and will be discarded

skipZeroAp.tooltip: AP=0 means no positives in candidates, cannot construct valid training samples

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: When enabled, validates positive/negative quality (keyword overlap filtering)

datasetRegister.title: Dataset Registration
datasetRegister.description: Automatically register to dataset management system upon completion

steps.qaToEvalDescription: QA → Eval Data mode: Performs vector retrieval for each record in the QA dataset, collects retrieval context to generate deep evaluation dataset. No LLM required, only uses Embedding model for vector retrieval.
steps.docToEvalDescription: Doc → Eval Data mode: First extracts QA pairs from documents, then performs vector retrieval for each QA, collects retrieval context to generate deep evaluation dataset. Does not perform positive/negative classification.
